_readme: Fixtures for the Kotenho hand renderer. handInput is riichi-score HandInput (feed straight back into calculate()); analysis is verbatim calculate() output. canonical reading = analysis.handInterpretations[0].
_gotchas: closedTiles does NOT include the winning tile. To draw the 14-tile hand, concatenate closedTiles + winningTile.tile. A hand with called melds has correspondingly fewer closedTiles.
handInterpretations is an ARRAY, sorted best-first. Some hands have >1 valid reading. canonical = handInterpretations[0].
canonical.groups is the full four-groups-plus-pair PARSE, with open melds appended. handInput.closedTiles/openMelds is what the player physically holds. Draw from handInput; explain from groups.
meld.type is "run" | "triplet" | "daiminkan" | "shouminkan" | "ankan". There is no "set" - it was renamed in riichi-score 3.0.
Meld is a DISCRIMINATED UNION. A called meld has `from` and `calledIndex`. An ankan has NEITHER - the fields are absent, not sentinels. Branch on type === "ankan", never on presence of `from`.
calledIndex indexes into that meld's own `tiles` array and names the tile to lay sideways. It never affects scoring, but it is validated, so it always points at a real tile.

A run (chi) is ALWAYS called from the caller's kamicha - the player on their left. calculate() rejects any other source. Relative seat: (WINDS.indexOf(from) - WINDS.indexOf(seatWind) + 4) % 4 -> 1 right, 2 across, 3 left.
Red fives are "0m"/"0p"/"0s", not "5m"/"5p"/"5s". They appear inside melds too.
Yakuman hands report han: 0 and carry `limit` ("yakuman" | "double-yakuman" | ...) instead. A naive han-times-fu display renders them as nothing.
Non-standard hands (chiitoitsu, kokushi) have `tiles` and NO `groups`/`pair`. Standard hands have `groups` + `pair` and no `tiles`. Discriminate on isStandardHand.
fuList is [{ reason, value }] objects - NOT [reason, value] tuples.
winningTile is a discriminated union: tsumo has isTsumo:true and no `from`; ron has `from` and no isTsumo. Never infer from presence of `from`.
seatPayments is per-seat: ron yields one entry, tsumo three. totalWinnings is their sum.
gameState.ruleset is a fully resolved snapshot, not a pointer.
honbaCount is accepted but currently ignored by the scorer (DATA-MODEL.md sec 12).

fixtures.name: closed-riichi-ron-kanchan
fixtures.note: Baseline. Closed, single interpretation, 1 han / 40 fu (raw 36), kanchan wait, ron from west.

fixtures.name: multiple-interpretations
fixtures.note: TWO valid readings, sorted best-first. canonical is handInterpretations[0]. Never assume length 1.

fixtures.name: open-melds
fixtures.note: Called chi and pon. `from` decides WHICH SLOT renders rotated (via relative seat); calledIndex decides which TILE sits in it. Two separate facts.

fixtures.name: concealed-kan-ankan
fixtures.note: ANKAN. Lives in openMelds but is CONCEALED, and has NO `from` and NO `calledIndex` at all - a called ankan is unrepresentable. Renders 2 face-down bracketing 2 face-up, with nothing rotated.

fixtures.name: called-kan-daiminkan
fixtures.note: DAIMINKAN - genuinely called, so `from` and calledIndex are both real. Contrast with the ankan fixture, which has neither.

fixtures.name: added-kan-shouminkan
fixtures.note: SHOUMINKAN — pon later upgraded to kan. Third distinct kan rendering; also the one that can be robbed (chankan).

fixtures.name: red-fives-akadora
fixtures.note: Aka dora. Red five is tile "0m"/"0p"/"0s", NOT "5m". Renderer MUST special-case rank 0 or it will draw the wrong tile.

fixtures.name: dealer-tsumo
fixtures.note: Dealer tsumo: three equal seatPayments ("X all"). winningTile has isTsumo:true and NO `from`.

fixtures.name: non-dealer-tsumo
fixtures.note: Non-dealer tsumo: three seatPayments, dealer pays double. Announced "X-Y".

fixtures.name: chiitoitsu
fixtures.note: NON-STANDARD: interpretation has `tiles`, and NO `groups`/`pair`. Flat 25 fu, never rounded.

fixtures.name: kokushi-yakuman
fixtures.note: NON-STANDARD yakuman. han is 0 — the score comes from `limit`. waitType is kokushi-specific.

fixtures.name: chi-called-middle-tile
fixtures.note: Chi where calledIndex is NOT 0. A renderer that hardcodes tiles[0] as the called tile fails here and passes everywhere else.

fixtures.name: honitsu-honors
fixtures.note: Honor tiles 1z-7z with one suit. Exercises honor rendering.
